description:
Single storey front extension incorporating porch; Single and two storey rear
extension; Alterations to roof to form rear dormer; Roof lights in front roof slope; Single
storey detached outbuilding at rear for use as Gym/Storage (Demolition of front porch
and ground floor front bay window)
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed on side elevations at ground floor of the of the development hereby permitted, without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse (<a href="https://harrow-planning.idoxcloud.com/locations/index.html?fa=edit&amp;id=2009687" target="_blank" data-id="2009687" class="trigger_location_popup no-underline" style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); outline: none; outline-offset: -2px;"><span data-update-object-name="Location" data-update-object-id="2009687" data-update-field-name="dtf_location_id">2 Ruskin Gardens, Kenton, Harrow, HA3 9QE</span></a>) and shall not be used as a separate unit of residential accommodation, without the prior permission in writing of the Local Planning Authority.</p><p><br></p>
